channel.title: Open Calls for Artists — Monographica
channel.description: Curated list of open calls for photographers and visual artists. Exhibitions, grants, residencies, and publications worldwide.

item.title: Swiss Art Awards 2027 · Federal Office of Culture
item.description: The Swiss federal art competition, held annually since 1899, is open to artists, architects, critics, editors and curators who are Swiss citizens or resident in Switzerland; the Art section sets no restriction on medium. Applicants submit a PDF dossier, and those selected present an original work in the Swiss Art Awards exhibition at Messe Basel. Students on an art or architecture course cannot enter unless they already hold a master's degree. — Deadline: December 3, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: CHF 25,000 + Exhibition.

item.title: We Represent · Studio Montclair
item.description: Studio Montclair's winter show at its Leach Gallery looks for work on heritage, identity, resilience and community, the pull between historical memory and lived experience, in any medium including video and installation. Up to three works, free for members and $42 otherwise, with cash awards; the non-profit keeps 30% of sales and local artists owe a two-hour gallery sit or a $40 fee. — Deadline: December 23, 2026. Fee: Free for members; $42 non-members. Prize: Cash awards + Exhibition.

item.title: Windows on the World · Schelfhaudt Gallery, University of Bridgeport
item.description: The Schelfhaudt Gallery at the University of Bridgeport wants photographs of people outside the United States in their everyday environment, not travel highlights but the struggles, joys and celebrations of ordinary life. Up to 20 images may be entered for the January to March 2027 show; framed work is preferred, artists pay shipping both ways, and the gallery takes 50% of any sale. — Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fee: $10 for the first image, $10 per additional image. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Turn the Soil · ARTS Southeast
item.description: ARTS Southeast's spring Supporter Exhibition in Savannah asks for new work tied to the natural world, including work made with natural materials. Current Supporters, from $25 students or $50 artists, may submit up to four wall-hanging works, capped at 30 inches in every direction, for a juried show running 21 January to 15 May 2027. ARTS Southeast takes no commission, so artists keep 100% of sales. — Deadline: January 9, 2027. Fee: Free (ARTS Southeast Supporter membership required, $50 artist tier / $25 student). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Jan van Eyck Academie Residency 2028
item.description: Eleven months in Maastricht among some 36 artists, curators, designers and writers, with a furnished studio apartment, a €1,500 monthly stipend (rent deducted), a €2,000 project budget and the academie's photography and audiovisual lab. Thirty to 32 places are chosen by a six-person committee for the 2028 cycle. Selected participants pay a €2,750 enrolment fee, and the €65 application fee is waived for DAC-list countries. — Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fee: €78.65 incl. VAT (waived for DAC-list countries). Prize: Residency + €1,500 monthly.

item.title: The Yunghi Grant 2026
item.description: Yunghi Kim's photojournalism grant, in its twelfth year, gives seven working freelance photojournalists $4,000 each, to start, continue or finish a project or simply to cover living costs. Jeffrey Smith of Contact Press Images and CNN Digital's Bernadette Tuazon judge; you email a 300-word case, one image and a portrait. Staff photographers, full-time educators and students are not eligible. — Deadline: December 6, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $4,000 grant.

item.title: 2027 Saltonstall Residency Fellowships · Constance Saltonstall Foundation for the Arts
item.description: Saltonstall hosts five people at a time on its Ithaca property, one of them a photographer or filmmaker, for a free two-, three- or four-week residency with a private apartment, its own black-and-white darkroom, $100 a week and up to $1,000 in need-based support. Seven-night residencies are reserved for parents and caregivers. Only year-round New York State residents aged 21 and over may apply. — Deadline: December 6, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Residency + $100 weekly.

item.title: New Terrain: A Juried Exhibition · Vermont Center for Photography
item.description: VCP's 2027 juried show looks forward, asking for photographs that imagine environmental futures: restoration and rewilding already underway, or landscapes built from speculation and invention. Lucas Foglia juries, and selected work hangs in the main gallery in Brattleboro from March to May 2027; any photographic medium, any age, any country. Accepted artists print, frame and ship their own work, and VCP keeps 40% of any sale. — Deadline: December 19, 2026. Fee: $20 ($10 members/students). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Creative Residency Program — Summer 2027 · Chulitna Lodge Wilderness Retreat
item.description: Chulitna Lodge sits 180 miles from the nearest road on Lake Clark in Alaska, fly-in only. Three fully funded six-week fellowships cover meals, lodging, the charter flight from Anchorage and a travel stipend; shorter one- to three-week residencies run $950–$1,900 a week. One 2027 fellowship is reserved for an Alaska resident. — Deadline: November 28, 2026. Fee: Paid. Prize: Residency + Travel stipend.

item.title: Macadam B&W Awards 2027 · Street Macadam
item.description: Third edition of Street Macadam's black-and-white award, themed Moments in Monochrome and open worldwide to street and documentary photographers aged 18 and over. The three winners take camera gear, show at the Mexico Street Photo Festival and appear in revue EPIC alongside ten honourable mentions. Entry runs €8 for one photo to €35 for ten. — Deadline: January 24, 2027. Fee: €8–€35. Prize: Ricoh camera + Exhibition + Publication.

item.title: From Woman 20 · UNDERSTORY
item.description: Curators Mary Urbas and Susan Snipes want work by women and non-binary artists from Northeast Ohio who left an art practice for five years or more and have started making again. Photography, including alternative process, is welcome, and six to ten artists get a month-long Cleveland show. No entry fee, no participation fee, 30% commission on sales. — Deadline: January 17, 2027. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Tiny Works · The Fulton Street Collective
item.description: The Fulton Street Collective's annual small-art group show takes work no longer than 13 inches on its longest side, frame included, with photographs and works on paper framed. Up to three pieces per artist, shown in the Chicago gallery from 4 December to 3 January. Hand delivery only: FSC accepts no shipped artwork. — Deadline: November 25, 2026. Fee: $35 (free for FSC members). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Der Greif x Belgrade Photo Month: Reborn Screening
item.description: Der Greif and Belgrade Photo Month want lens-based work on being reborn: transformation alongside continuity in personal identities, collective histories, shifting landscapes or changing societies. Selected participants are showcased in the festival's main screening event in Belgrade on 9 May 2027. Up to 15 images per project, and the €15 donation is optional. — Deadline: February 10, 2027. Fee: Free (non-compulsory €15 donation). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: 14th Annual Abstract Sanctuary · Verum Ultimum Art Gallery
item.description: Verum Ultimum's long-running abstraction show returns for a 14th edition, open internationally to painters, printmakers, photographers, digital artists and sculptors working non-objectively. The exhibition is virtual: an online gallery page with scale views, blog posts and four weeks of promotion, a 30% commission on sales and no cash award. Two images are required, up to five allowed. — Deadline: January 26, 2027. Fee: $25 (2 images) + $5 each. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: It's a GREAT Big World · Arts at The Canopy
item.description: Arts at The Canopy, a gallery and arts campus in downtown Ocala, asks artists what “the world” means to them — a city skyline, a dirt road, a kitchen table, something abstract. Photography is among the accepted media for this national online show, juried by Ronda Richley, with $200, $100 and $75 awards. AI-generated work is not eligible. — Deadline: January 16, 2027. Fee: $35 (2 works) + $5 each. Prize: $200 prize + Exhibition.

item.title: Comic Relief — Wit, Irony, and the Unexpected · Der Greif
item.description: Der Greif Pulse asks lens-based artists for visual humour that goes past the punchline: dry irony, deadpan observation, physical comedy, playful disruption. Selected projects go into an online exhibition on Der Greif's Pulse section plus a small-group critique session, with a possible invitation to Der Greif Studio. One project of at least ten images. — Deadline: December 11, 2026. Fee: Free (optional €10 donation). Prize: Online exhibition + Critique.

item.title: Metamorphosis vol. I — Art, Performance and Celebration · Exhibit Around
item.description: dotART and Exhibit Around take Ovid as a starting point for a six-volume photography project, and the first volume is about transformation in art, performance and collective celebration. Entry is free — three single photos for non-members — with selected work printed in the book and shown at Trieste Photo Days 2027. Prizes include a Celiberti sculpture and two nights in Trieste. — Deadline: January 31, 2027. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition + Book + Trieste stay.

item.title: 2027 International Krappy Kamera Competition · Soho Photo Gallery
item.description: Soho Photo Gallery's long-running competition asks for photographs made with lousy lenses — Holga, Diana, Ansco, pinhole, or a DSLR wearing a pinhole body cap. Juror Gordon Stettinius selects; winners show in the gallery's Chelsea space and online, with $300, $200 and $100 prizes. Phones, disposables and point-and-shoots are ineligible, and winners must frame their own prints. — Deadline: January 11, 2027. Fee: $45 (1-5 images) + $5 each. Prize: $300 prize + Exhibition.

item.title: #NewVisions2027 · Texas Photographic Society
item.description: Texas Photographic Society's annual online student competition is open-themed and open to college students worldwide, in any photographic process from silver and alternative to collage and book arts. Juror Robin Dru Germany picks 50 images; cash awards run $300, $200 and $100, and every selected artist gets a free year of TPS student membership. Entry is $20 for five images. — Deadline: February 20, 2027. Fee: $20 (5 images) + $5 each. Prize: $300 prize + Exhibition + Membership.

item.title: Changes: Nothing Stays · Ludington Area Center for the Arts
item.description: The Ludington Area Center for the Arts asks what happens when something becomes something else: personal growth, cultural shifts, environmental transformation, political upheaval, emotional evolution, physical metamorphosis. Photography sits among the eleven accepted media, alongside collage, video, installation and sculpture. International, 18+, $30 for two works, with the show running 5–27 March 2027. — Deadline: January 31, 2027. Fee: $30. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Deep Focus 2027: Long-Term Projects · Atlanta Photography Group
item.description: Atlanta Photography Group wants bodies of work built over time — return visits, patient observation, a lasting relationship with a place, a community or a question. Juror Michael Itkoff of Daylight Books picks 18 photographers, each showing three or four images at the Ansley Mall gallery. APG membership is required, and need-based fee scholarships are offered. — Deadline: December 14, 2026. Fee: $40–$70 (members) / $20–$50 (students); $50 base after Dec 10. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: photoED Magazine — Faces (Issue #80)
item.description: photoED, the Canadian photography magazine, is building Issue #80 around portraiture: fine art projects that document ourselves through unique lens-based methods. Existing work only, eight images maximum, blind reviewed by the magazine's volunteer editorial board. Entry is free for print subscribers and Patreon patrons, $20 CAD otherwise, and waived on request for artists who cannot pay. — Deadline: June 14, 2027. Fee: $20 CAD (subscribers and Patreon patrons free). Prize: Publication.

item.title: photoED Magazine — Place (Issue #81)
item.description: photoED, the Canadian photography magazine, is building Issue #81 around place: fine art projects that tell the stories of landscapes, rooms, cities and towns through unique lens-based methods. Existing work only, eight images maximum, blind reviewed by the magazine's volunteer editorial board. Entry is free for print subscribers and Patreon patrons, $20 CAD otherwise. — Deadline: September 10, 2027. Fee: $20 CAD (subscribers and Patreon patrons free). Prize: Publication.

item.title: Yaritori Creative Residency 2027
item.description: A 45-day residency in Matsudo, outside Tokyo, with accommodation at Paradise AIR and €2,200 towards flights and daily costs, ending in an exhibition or event at the Portuguese Embassy. Photography is a named field, and applications are free. Only Portuguese nationals and people resident in Portugal for over five years may apply, and the whole application must be written in Portuguese. — Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: 45-day residency + €2,200 grant.

item.title: 48 Stunden Neukölln 2027 — Soft Rituals
item.description: Berlin's Neukölln district becomes a 48-hour open gallery every June, and anyone may apply with a project on the 2027 theme, Soft Rituals. No venue or Berlin address is needed to apply: a jury decides in February, and selected artists then find and link a Neukölln space. Funding for 2027 is not yet approved, so the edition may be scaled down. — Deadline: January 10, 2027. Fee: Free. Prize: Festival exhibition.

item.title: Made You Look — SaveArtSpace Bus Shelter Exhibition
item.description: SaveArtSpace puts artwork on Miami bus shelter ad space for at least a month from January 22, 2027, curated by Pangea Kali Virga. The brief asks for maximalist, witty, attention-grabbing work that reclaims the visual landscape from passive consumption. Open to artists of all ages; fees are tax-deductible donations that buy the ad space, and anyone who cannot afford to donate may submit by email instead. — Deadline: December 14, 2026. Fee: $35 (1–3 images) + $10 each additional ($36.92–$108.45 at checkout). Prize: Public exhibition.

item.title: stern-Preis 2027 — Fotogeschichte des Jahres (Photo Story of the Year)
item.description: Germany's most established journalism award honours the photo story of the year: a series that illuminates a major event or aspect of social life with journalistic force. Any subject worldwide qualifies, but the story must have been published in German-language press during 2026. Entry is free. — Deadline: January 8, 2027. Fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: The Abstract Image · Praxis Photo Arts Center
item.description: International juried exhibition at Praxis Gallery in Minneapolis for photographs that move beyond literal representation, using colour, light, shadow, texture, shape or line. All genres, capture methods and post-production are welcome. Up to 38 works are selected for the gallery show and the online archive; entrants must be 18 or older. — Deadline: December 13, 2026. Fee: $35 (5 images) + $5 each additional. Prize: Exhibition + catalog.

item.title: ZK/U Residency Open Call 2026
item.description: ZK/U's general open call selects practitioners for two- to six-month residencies in a former railway depot in Berlin-Moabit, with a studio, living space and a public programme of open studios and dinners. Residencies are self-funded: the monthly fee is €750 to €1,200, and successful applicants have two years to take up a place. — Deadline: December 18, 2026. Fee: Free (€750–€1,200/month if selected). Prize: Residency.

item.title: THE BLANC Artist Residency 2027–2028
item.description: THE BLANC gives emerging and mid-career visual artists a fully subsidised 300 sq ft studio in Midtown Manhattan for two to three months, plus a $500 materials stipend. The studio is non-live-in, so artists must be in New York for the whole period. Four sessions run from May 2027 to April 2028. — Deadline: February 15, 2027. Fee: $25. Prize: Residency + $500 stipend.

item.title: Curatorial Open Call — March 2027 · Northmere Gallery
item.description: Northmere Gallery hands its Marylebone space to an independent curator or collective for the first week of March 2027, with no prescribed theme. Free use of the gallery and on-site technical assistance are offered, but there is no production budget and no curatorial fee. Apply by email with a single PDF. — Deadline: December 24, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Athens Digital Arts Festival 2027 — It's Alive
item.description: The 23rd edition of Greece's longest-running digital arts festival returns to Athens in spring 2027 on the theme It's Alive, about techno-animism and the blurred line between humans and machines. Photographers enter through the Digital Image category, which takes a series of up to five works in one application. There is no entry fee. — Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Festival exhibition.

item.title: Equinox: Experimental & Handmade Photography · Light Poets Guild
item.description: A juried show of photographic work in which a handmade or experimental process is central: prints coated, brushed, toned or scratched, camera-less images, photographic objects, books and sculpture. Juried by Michael Kirchoff of Analog Forever Magazine and shown at The Gallery @ArtGym Denver during Month of Photography, 5-21 March 2027. Open to artists 18 and over living in North America. — Deadline: January 17, 2027. Fee: $40 (up to 5 images). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Nude Nite 2027 Orlando
item.description: Nude Nite's Orlando edition runs three nights in early February 2027 at a venue still to be announced, with figurative artwork, installations and live performance, and photography is a named medium. Selected artists show in front of thousands of visitors and get free admission plus guest passes; sales split 60/40. US residents, 18-plus. — Deadline: January 7, 2027. Fee: $40. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Nude Nite 2027 Tampa Bay
item.description: Nude Nite's Tampa Bay edition runs three nights in late February or early March 2027, a figurative art event mixing artwork with installations and performance; photography is a named medium. The venue and exact dates are still to be announced. Open to US residents aged 18 and over. — Deadline: January 28, 2027. Fee: $40. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Brighton Artist Showcase — April 2027 · Arrival Gallery
item.description: Arrival Gallery's three-day Brighton group show runs 16–18 April 2027 at 18 Lower Rock Gardens, for painters, photographers, digital and other visual artists. Applying is free; selected artists pay from £65 for a digital place or £165 for a physical one, and the full fee is sent only after selection. AI-assisted work is accepted. — Deadline: April 1, 2027. Fee: Free (£65+ digital, £165+ physical if selected). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: LensCulture Art Photography Awards 2027
item.description: LensCulture's contemporary-art award, open worldwide to professionals and amateurs: conceptual, experimental, cameraless, analog and mixed-media work all welcome. $10,000 in cash is split across series and single-image places, and winners are exhibited during Photo London 2027 with a solo feature on LensCulture. One single image enters free. — Deadline: December 16, 2026. Fee: Free–$45 ($35/5 single images, $10 per extra image; 30% student discount). Prize: $10,000 cash + Exhibition + Solo feature.

item.title: Noorderlicht Biennale 2027 Open Call — PLAY!
item.description: Noorderlicht's 2027 biennale invites photographers and lens-based artists worldwide to propose existing, adapted or new work on play — including AI, generative, interactive and game-based pieces. Around 75 artists show across Groningen, Friesland and Drenthe from September 2027; each is paid a Mondriaan Fund artist fee of €640 to €3,179 and Noorderlicht covers printing, framing, insurance and transport. — Deadline: December 15, 2026. Fee: €5 per project. Prize: €640-€3,179 fee + Exhibition.

item.title: FY 2027 Juried Exhibition Grant: Art of Water and Waterways · DC Commission on the Arts and Humanities
item.description: The District's arts commission pays artists to show work in a juried themed exhibition at its 200 I Street gallery, this cycle on water and waterways — the Anacostia watershed, stormwater, Indigenous water knowledge. Grants run up to $2,000; applicants must have lived in Washington, DC for at least a year. — Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: $2,000 grant + Exhibition.

item.title: Nature Photographer of the Year 2027
item.description: The twelfth edition of the Dutch nature photography competition, open worldwide to professionals and amateurs across eleven image categories, a free youth category for ages 10–17, and the Fred Hazelhoff portfolio award. Staged nature and AI-generated images are disqualified. — Deadline: March 21, 2027. Fee: Free–€44 (€49.50 after 24 Jan). Prize: €3,000 cash + €500 category.

item.title: Photography of the Year 2026 · Grid Photo Gallery
item.description: Grid Photo Gallery's second annual best-of-the-year competition, open worldwide to any genre or subject. The winning image takes €500 and the Photography of the Year title; selected work enters a curated online exhibition kept permanently on the gallery site. Entry is €10 per image, with no limit on submissions. — Deadline: January 15, 2027. Fee: €10. Prize: €500 cash + Exhibition.

item.title: International Photography Awards 2027
item.description: The 2027 edition of the International Photography Awards, the Lucie Foundation's sister competition. $47,500 in cash prizes is headed by $10,000 for International Photographer of the Year and $5,000 for Discovery of the Year. Professional, non-professional and student entries are judged separately, and winners join the Best of Show exhibition and the IPA Annual Book. — Deadline: June 30, 2027. Fee: $20–$65. Prize: $10,000 cash + IPA Trophy + Exhibition.

item.title: 2027 ZEKE Awards · Social Documentary Network
item.description: Social Documentary Network's annual awards for documentary photography and for visual stories about systemic change. Two first-place photographers each receive $2,500, a feature in ZEKE Magazine and in The Guardian US; honourable mentions are published too. Entries are projects of six to thirty photographs, open to amateurs and professionals worldwide. — Deadline: January 15, 2027. Fee: $30 through December 31, then $35. Prize: $2,500 cash + ZEKE Magazine + Guardian US.

item.title: Facade · NKollectiv
item.description: NKollectiv's Englewood gallery invites Colorado photographers to show work for Month of Photography Denver 2027, on the theme of what surfaces reveal and conceal. Any photographic process qualifies, as long as photography stays the primary medium. Accepted prints arrive framed or mounted, no wider than 36 inches, with a 35% gallery commission on sales. — Deadline: February 1, 2027. Fee: $25. Prize: Exhibition + Juror award.

item.title: Depth of Field: Prelude to the Month of Photography · Core Art Space
item.description: CORE's run-up to Denver's Month of Photography asks for work that shows your depth of field, from traditional processes to alternative ones. Armando Martinez juries up to three entries per artist for a two-week show at the gallery on West Colfax in Lakewood. Open to artists 18 and over nationally; CORE takes 30% on sales. — Deadline: January 19, 2027. Fee: $35 for up to 3 entries. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: SE Center for Photography — The Forgotten
item.description: A physical show in the SE Center's new gallery space on people, places and belongings that once mattered and are now out of mind, in any process from analog to antique. Michael Pannier picks 35-40 prints for a month on the walls plus a show catalogue, and the centre mats and frames selected work free. — Deadline: January 24, 2027. Fee: $35/5 images ($28 members) + $6 each addl to 15 ($5 members). Prize: Exhibition + Catalog.

item.title: Delfina Foundation — Lithuanian Culture Institute Residency 2027
item.description: Delfina Foundation and the Lithuanian Culture Institute fund a twelve-week London residency in the spring 2027 Collecting as Practice season, for artists whose work asks what gets kept, archived and remembered. The package covers flights, a single room, £40 a day and a £1,000 materials budget. Applicants must have been active in Lithuania's art scene for three years. — Deadline: January 4, 2027. Fee: Free. Prize: Funded residency + £1,000 budget.

item.title: Stories of Immigration at Four Mile
item.description: Denver's 1859 stagecoach-stop museum marks Month of Photography with a juried show on immigration stories, judging analog and digital entries separately. Top scorers in each category win a one-month solo exhibition in the park's education center plus $50, and selected work is delivered ready to hang. Human-made photographs only. — Deadline: February 7, 2027. Fee: $15 per work. Prize: Solo exhibition + $50.

item.title: Wildlife of Lakewood Photography Exhibition · Sustainable Eiber
item.description: A free neighbourhood-run show at the James J. Richey Gallery in Lakewood's Civic Center for photographs of local wildlife, open to Lakewood residents of any age or experience and to images made in the city since January 2025. A panel of Lakewood curators and guest jurors reviews up to four framed, ready-to-hang works per photographer. — Deadline: January 31, 2027. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: New Generation: Month of Photography Teen Show 2027 · Colorado Art Awards
item.description: A juried show for Colorado high-school photography students, run with Denver's Month of Photography and hosted at the Lakewood Cultural Center from late January. Entry is free, one image per student, and awards are given. Selected work is dropped off and collected at Mile High Framing, and AI-generated images are barred. — Deadline: December 4, 2026. Fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition + Awards.
